AUTOSAR Classic Überblick & Modulkatalog

Application Layer & RTE

Runtime Environment (RTE), Virtual Functional Bus

System Services

ECU State Manager (EcuM), BSW Mode Manager (BswM), Watchdog Manager (WdgM)

Operating System

OS (Tasks, Events, Alarms, Schedule Tables)

Communication Services

COM (Signals, IPDUs), PduR (PDU Router)

Memory Services

NvM (Non-Volatile RAM Manager), MemIf, Fee, Ea

Diagnostic Services

DEM, DCM, DET, DLT (ISO 14229 UDS, DTCs, Error Tracer)

Security & Crypto

Crypto Service Manager (CSM), CryIf

Security & Intrusion Detection

IdsM (Intrusion Detection), SecOC (Secure Onboard Communication), KeyM (Key Manager)

ECU Abstraction — CAN

CAN Interface (CanIf), CAN Transceiver (CanTrcv)

ECU Abstraction — LIN

LIN Interface (LinIf), LIN Driver (Lin), LIN State Manager (LinSM), LinTrcv

ECU Abstraction — FlexRay

FlexRay Interface (FrIf), FlexRay Driver (Fr), FrSM, FrTp, FrTrcv

ECU Abstraction — Ethernet

Ethernet Interface (EthIf), SoAd, TcpIp

Microcontroller Abstraction (MCAL)

Drivers (Port, DIO, SPI, ADC, PWM, Flash, WDG)

General & Standard Types

Platform Types (Platform_Types.h), Standard Types (Std_Types.h), Communication Stack Types (ComStack_Types.h)
Dieses Verzeichnis macht die erfasste Quellenbasis der AUTOSAR Classic Platform R20-11 transparent. Die Spezifikationsdokumente bilden die Grundlage für die Architektur- und Modulbeschreibungen.
